def safe_signal(value):
 assert set(value)=={'signal'}
 signal=value['signal']
 assert set(signal)=={'peer','type','payload','mid'}
 assert signal['type'] in ('offer','answer','candidate')
 return value
async def main():
 command='cd /Users/eric/Developer/Halo2-macos-port && export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && '+shlex.join(['python3','-B','tools/run_test.py','--scratch-root','.local/test-scratch','--','python3','-B','-c',WORKER])
 native=await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec('ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=15','codex-mac',command,stdin=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE)
 report['native_command']=['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','codex-mac','<owned worker; source retained in evidence>']
 remote=None
 try:
  prepared=json.loads(await asyncio.wait_for(native.stdout.readline(),900))
  assert prepared.get('ready'),prepared
  report['prepared']=prepared['metadata']
  for arch in ['arm64','x86_64']:
   row={'arch':arch,'receipts':{},'signal_counts':{'native':0,'remote':0}}
   report['runs'].append(row)
   remote_command='PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /opt/halo2/tests/direct-peer-venv/bin/python -B /opt/halo2/tests/online_peer_wan_echo.py'
   remote=await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec('ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=15','halo2-master',remote_command,stdin=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE)
   native.stdin.write((json.dumps({'start':arch})+'\n').encode());await native.stdin.drain()
   async def from_native():
    while line:=await native.stdout.readline():
     value=json.loads(line)
     if 'signal' in value:
      safe_signal(value);row['signal_counts']['native']+=1
      remote.stdin.write(line);await remote.stdin.drain()
     elif 'native_exit' in value:
      assert value['arch']==arch;row['native_exit']=value['native_exit']
      if not remote.stdin.is_closing():
       remote.stdin.write(b'{"stop":true}\n');await remote.stdin.drain()
      return
     else:
      assert set(value)<={'done','sent','received','rtt_ms'} and value.get('done')
      row['receipts']['native']=value
      remote.stdin.write(b'{"stop":true}\n');await remote.stdin.drain()
    raise RuntimeError('Mac worker ended before the native receipt')
   async def from_remote():
    while line:=await remote.stdout.readline():
     value=json.loads(line)
     if 'signal' in value:
      safe_signal(value);row['signal_counts']['remote']+=1
      native.stdin.write(line);await native.stdin.drain()
     else:
      assert set(value)=={'done','received'} and value.get('done')
      row['receipts']['remote']=value
   tasks=[asyncio.create_task(from_native()),asyncio.create_task(from_remote())]
   try:
    async with asyncio.timeout(60):
     await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
     row['remote_exit']=await remote.wait()
     error=await remote.stderr.read();row['remote_stderr_bytes']=len(error);row['remote_stderr_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(error).hexdigest()
    row['passed']=row.get('native_exit')==row.get('remote_exit')==0 and row['receipts'].get('native',{}).get('received',0)>=45 and row['receipts'].get('remote',{}).get('received',0)>=45
   finally:
    for task in tasks:
     if not task.done():task.cancel()
    await asyncio.gather(*tasks,return_exceptions=True)
    if remote.returncode is None:
     remote.kill();await remote.wait()
    remote=None
  native.stdin.write(b'{"stop":true}\n');await native.stdin.drain()

  report['worker_exit']=await asyncio.wait_for(native.wait(),30)

from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();scratch=Path(os.environ['HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH'])
output=root/'build/test-results/macos-wan-build';output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def emit(d):print(json.dumps(d),flush=True)
report={'schema':'H2_MACOS_WAN_WORKER_V1','scratch':str(scratch),'runs':[],'retained_large_artifacts':[]}
try:
 with (scratch/'preparation.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'tests/macos/python/prepare_sdk.py'),str(scratch/'graphics')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 graphics=scratch/'graphics'
 command=[sys.executable,'-B',str(root/'tools/run_tests.py'),'--build-worker','--source',str(root),'--output',str(output),'--target','online_peer_wan_probe','--target','vulkan_portability_tests','--filter','^vulkan_portability$','--jobs','2','--test-jobs','1','--cmake-arg=-GNinja',f'--cmake-arg=-DSDL2_DIR={graphics}/sdk/cmake/SDL2',f'--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_MOLTENVK_LIBRARY={graphics}/sdk/MoltenVK/MoltenVK/dynamic/dylib/macOS/libMoltenVK.dylib',f'--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_MOLTENVK_LICENSE={graphics}/sdk/MoltenVK/LICENSE',f'--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_SDL_LICENSE={graphics}/SDL2-LICENSE.txt','--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_STAGE_BUILD_OUTPUT=OFF','--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_BUNDLE_MOVIES=OFF','--cmake-arg=-DHALO2_MACOS_DEPENDENCY_JOBS=4','--retain-report','macos-dependencies/openssl/manifest.json']
 report['build_command']=command
 with (scratch/'build-worker.log').open('w') as log:
  subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 binary=scratch/'build/online_peer_wan_probe'
 report['binary_sha256']=digest(binary)
 report['architectures']=subprocess.run(['lipo','-archs',str(binary)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip().split()
 assert set(report['architectures'])=={'arm64','x86_64'}
 sources=['CMakeLists.txt','cmake/OnlinePeers.cmake','src/online_peer_transport.cpp','include/halo2/online_peer_transport.hpp','tools/online_peer_wan_probe.cpp','tests/macos/python/prepare_sdk.py','tools/macos/test_port.py']
 report['source_sha256']={p:digest(root/p) for p in sources}
 report['graphics_inputs']=json.loads((graphics/'manifest.json').read_text())
 emit({'ready':True,'metadata':report})
 for arch in ['arm64','x86_64']:
  request=json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
  assert request=={'start':arch}
  result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/arch','-'+arch,str(binary)],stdin=sys.stdin.buffer,stdout=sys.stdout,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=45)
  stderr=result.stderr
  row={'arch':arch,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stderr_bytes':len(stderr),'stderr_sha256':hashlib.sha256(stderr).hexdigest(),'diagnostics':[s for s in stderr.decode(errors='replace').splitlines() if s in ['WAN direct UDP did not deliver enough authenticated datagrams','Unable to establish a direct player connection.','WAN packet endpoint or size differs','WAN packet serial differs','WAN payload differs']]}
  report['runs'].append(row)
  emit({'native_exit':result.returncode,'arch':arch})
 assert json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())=={'stop':True}
 report['passed']=all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in report['runs'])
except BaseException as error:
 report.update(passed=False,error_class=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:1500])
 for name in ['preparation.log','build-worker.log']:
  path=scratch/name
  if path.exists():report.setdefault('failure_tails',{})[name]=path.read_text(errors='replace')[-4000:]
 emit({'worker_error':report.get('error_class')})
finally:
 (output/'worker-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
sys.exit(0 if report.get('passed') else 1)
